lines.speaker: PIPI
lines.text: Alert. The Moon is broken. Last week: big circle. Tonight: tiny smile. Someone is eating it.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [worried][beeping nervously] Alert! [short pause] The Moon is broken. [gasps] Last week: big circle. [pause] Tonight: tiny smile. [dramatic] Someone... is eating it!
lines.spoken_text: Alert! The Moon is broken. Last week: big circle. Tonight: tiny smile. Someone... is eating it!

lines.speaker: BRAVO
lines.text: Nobody is eating the Moon, Pipi. But it DOES look like it changes shape. Want to know why?
lines.elevenlabs_text: [warm][amused] Nobody is eating the Moon, Pipi. [chuckles] [pause] But it DOES look like it changes shape. [curious][slowly] Want to know why?
lines.spoken_text: Nobody is eating the Moon, Pipi. But it DOES look like it changes shape. Want to know why?

lines.speaker: PIPI
lines.text: Yes. Science snack. Go.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [excited][giggles] Yes! [laughs] Science snack! [eager] Go go go!
lines.spoken_text: Yes! Science snack! Go go go!

lines.speaker: BRAVO
lines.text: First big secret: the Moon is a ball. A giant rocky ball floating in space. It does not shrink. It does not melt.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [friendly][clear] First big secret: [pause] the Moon is a ball. [pause] A giant rocky ball floating in space. [gently] It does not shrink. [short pause] It does not melt.
lines.spoken_text: First big secret: the Moon is a ball. A giant rocky ball floating in space. It does not shrink. It does not melt.

lines.speaker: PIPI
lines.text: Ball confirmed. Squishy version is smaller.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [playful] Ball confirmed. [pokes] Squishy version is smaller. [laughs] Hehe. Cute Moon.
lines.spoken_text: Ball confirmed. Squishy version is smaller. Hehe. Cute Moon.

lines.speaker: BRAVO
lines.text: Second secret: the Moon does not make its own light. The Sun lights it up. Like this.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [excited] Second secret: [pause] the Moon does not make its own light. [happy] The Sun lights it up. [delighted] Like this!
lines.spoken_text: Second secret: the Moon does not make its own light. The Sun lights it up. Like this!

lines.speaker: PIPI
lines.text: Ooooh. One cheek sunny. One cheek sleepy.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [amazed] Ooooh! [giggles] One cheek sunny... [whispers playfully] one cheek sleepy. [laughs]
lines.spoken_text: Ooooh! One cheek sunny... one cheek sleepy.

lines.speaker: BRAVO
lines.text: We live on Earth. The Moon travels around us. As it moves, we see different sunny pieces of that ball.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [warm teacher] We live on Earth. [pause] The Moon travels around us. [slowly] As it moves... we see different sunny pieces of that ball.
lines.spoken_text: We live on Earth. The Moon travels around us. As it moves... we see different sunny pieces of that ball.

lines.speaker: BRAVO
lines.text: When the sunny side faces us  -  we see a FULL MOON. A bright circle.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [happy][bright] When the sunny side faces us... [pause] we see a FULL MOON! [excited] A bright circle!
lines.spoken_text: When the sunny side faces us... we see a FULL MOON! A bright circle!

lines.speaker: PIPI
lines.text: Big cookie.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [delighted] Big cookie! [laughs harder] Nom nom! Wait. [serious funny] Do not eat the Moon cookie.
lines.spoken_text: Big cookie! Nom nom! Wait. Do not eat the Moon cookie.

lines.speaker: BRAVO
lines.text: When we mostly see the dark side  -  almost no cookie. That is a NEW MOON. The Moon is still there. It is just hiding in the Sun's shadow from our view.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [gentle][soft] When we mostly see the dark side... [pause] almost no cookie. [clear] That is a NEW MOON. [reassuring] The Moon is still there. [pause] It is just hiding in the Sun's shadow... from our view.
lines.spoken_text: When we mostly see the dark side... almost no cookie. That is a NEW MOON. The Moon is still there. It is just hiding in the Sun's shadow... from our view.

lines.speaker: PIPI
lines.text: Not eaten. Just sneaky.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [relieved][sighs happily] Not eaten. [mischievously] Just sneaky. [giggles] Sneaky Moon.
lines.spoken_text: Not eaten. Just sneaky. Sneaky Moon.

lines.speaker: BRAVO
lines.text: In between, we get shapes with funny names. Like a banana. That is a CRESCENT.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [cheerful] In between, we get shapes with funny names. [pause] Like a banana. [playful] That is a CRESCENT.
lines.spoken_text: In between, we get shapes with funny names. Like a banana. That is a CRESCENT.

lines.speaker: PIPI
lines.text: Moon banana. Do not eat.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [snorts][laughing] Moon banana! [pause] Do not eat. [whispers] Pipi already tried. [giggles] Fake news.
lines.spoken_text: Moon banana! Do not eat. Pipi already tried. Fake news.

lines.speaker: BRAVO
lines.text: Half lit is a HALF MOON. And when it is almost full, we call it a GIBBOUS  -  which just means 'bumpy almost-circle.'
lines.elevenlabs_text: [clear][friendly] Half lit is a HALF MOON. [pause] And when it is almost full, we call it a GIBBOUS... [chuckles] which just means bumpy almost-circle.
lines.spoken_text: Half lit is a HALF MOON. And when it is almost full, we call it a GIBBOUS... which just means bumpy almost-circle.

lines.speaker: BRAVO
lines.text: The whole show takes about one month. Same Moon. Same ball. Different sunny slice for our eyes.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [warm][slowly] The whole show takes about one month. [pause] Same Moon. [short pause] Same ball. [gentle] Different sunny slice for our eyes.
lines.spoken_text: The whole show takes about one month. Same Moon. Same ball. Different sunny slice for our eyes.

lines.speaker: PIPI
lines.text: Shape change equals view change. Download complete.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [proud][robotic cute] Shape change equals view change. [pause] [laughs] Download complete! [happy beep]
lines.spoken_text: Shape change equals view change. Download complete!

lines.speaker: BRAVO
lines.text: So next time you look up and the Moon looks skinny, remember: it did not shrink. You are just seeing a different piece of sunlight.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [calm][sincere] So next time you look up and the Moon looks skinny... [pause] remember: [softly] it did not shrink. [warm] You are just seeing a different piece of sunlight.
lines.spoken_text: So next time you look up and the Moon looks skinny... remember: it did not shrink. You are just seeing a different piece of sunlight.

lines.speaker: PIPI
lines.text: Tonight homework: find the Moon. Ask: banana, half, or cookie?
lines.elevenlabs_text: [soft][to kids][friendly] Tonight homework: [pause] find the Moon. [playful] Ask: banana... [giggles] half... or cookie? [laughs]
lines.spoken_text: Tonight homework: find the Moon. Ask: banana... half... or cookie?

lines.speaker: BRAVO
lines.text: Great question, Pipi. And a great sky. Widgeteers Explains  -  mystery solved.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [confident][warm wrap-up] Great question, Pipi. [chuckles] And a great sky. [pause][proud] Widgeteers Explains... [smiles] mystery solved.
lines.spoken_text: Great question, Pipi. And a great sky. Widgeteers Explains... mystery solved.
